plans.idea: Keep the original's left-to-right structure: a left text column with the headline over the subheadline and the CTA directly below it, all on one left edge, and the phone tall on the right, scaled up so it balances the copy.
Mirrored split: the phone, full height, anchors the left edge and the eye moves right into the headline, subheadline and CTA, which share a left edge just past the phone.

Headline-first poster: a full-width text band at the top lets 'Sweat smarter.' run large, then a lower row pairs the CTA on the left with the phone in the bottom-right, so the eye goes headline, then CTA, then product.
